description: University-approved Google Gemini App, protected by the University's Google agreement and approved for defined University data use.
howToObtain: Use the Gemini web or mobile app with a University of Alberta CCID/Google Workspace account.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: IST identifies Gemini App as a core Google Workspace service supported by IST and protected by the University of Alberta's agreement with Google. It gives web and mobile access paths and says interactions stay within the University and are not used to improve Google's generative-AI models.

The University calls Gemini App an institutionally approved, free and secure tool. It says Gemini is the only generative-AI platform approved for University of Alberta data and specifies Gemini via the user's CCID as an institutionally approved tool.
